title: EsriAccessFootprint
description: Read-only export of an Esri estate's identity / RBAC posture (users, roles+privileges, groups, per-service permissions, item sharing, org security config) produced by honua-esri-assess from documented ArcGIS /arcgis/admin/security, /arcgis/admin/services, and Portal admin/community endpoints. It is a documented SIBLING of EsriFootprint.json and drives Honua RBAC + the Portal facade. Schema version esri-access-footprint/v0.2 (full SemVer in $id) is an additive successor to v0.1: it adds per-service ACE detail (operations) and a resolved effectivePermissions collapse. Schema version is carried in-band. v0.x is unstable; v1.0 is the first stable promise. Credentials, tokens, query strings, and URL userinfo are never present in any field.

schemaVersion.description: Major.minor of the access-footprint contract carried in-band. v0.2 is additive over v0.1. Full SemVer (e.g. v0.2.0) lives in $id.

generatedAt.description: When the scanner finished producing this artifact (RFC3339 UTC).

users.description: Identity principals enumerated from the source. Never carries passwords, tokens, or secrets.

servicePermissions.description: Per-service access-control entries (ACEs) observed by crawling documented admin security endpoints (/arcgis/admin/services/<service>/permissions). Each entry is one principal->effect ACE on one service.

effectivePermissions.description: Resolved, deterministic collapse of the raw servicePermissions ACEs into one effective grant per (service, principal). Additive in v0.2. Resolution is documented: deny overrides allow for the same principal; the union of operations is preserved; principalType precedence and the 'everyone' principal are recorded verbatim so a downstream policy engine can re-derive grants.

itemSharing.description: Item sharing posture (private/org/public/shared) for portal items.

diagnostics.description: Typed, prospect-safe diagnostics. Raw exceptions and stack traces are forbidden and excluded from the schema.

RFC3339.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with an explicit Z suffix.

name.description: Only honua-esri-assess is part of the contract at v0.2.

kind.description: RBAC export targets ArcGIS Online/Enterprise Portal and ArcGIS Server only. FileGDB has no identity surface.

locator.description: Prospect-safe identifier. Never includes credentials, query strings, fragments, or URL userinfo.

username.description: Stable principal identifier. Not an email or secret.

roleId.description: Identifier of the role granted to this user.

groupIds.description: Group ids this user belongs to.

userType.description: Esri user-type license id when exposed.

provider.description: Identity provider that backs this principal.

disabled.description: Whether the account is disabled at the source.

type.description: Built-in role family, or custom for org-defined roles.

privileges.description: Documented Esri privilege identifiers granted to the role (e.g. portal:user:createItem).

roleId.description: Role linked to this group, when the org maps group->role.

serviceUrl.description: Credentials-stripped service URL; userinfo, query strings, and fragments are rejected.

principalType.description: Kind of principal the ACE applies to.

principal.description: Identifier of the principal (role id, username, group id, or '*' for everyone).

operations.description: Documented Esri operations the ACE governs (e.g. Query, Create, Update, Delete, Uploads). Empty means the service-level grant with no operation breakdown. Additive in v0.2.

serviceUrl.description: Credentials-stripped service URL the effective grant applies to.

principalType.description: Kind of principal the effective grant applies to.

principal.description: Identifier of the principal (role id, username, group id, or '*' for everyone).

effect.description: Resolved effect after collapsing every ACE for this (service, principal). Deny overrides allow.

operations.description: Union of every operation observed across the collapsed ACEs for this (service, principal), sorted for determinism.

access.description: Effective sharing level of the item.

sharedGroupIds.description: Group ids the item is explicitly shared with.

defaultRoleId.description: Role assigned to new members, when exposed.
